_doc: Reputation quartermasters' gear (tools/build_faction_rewards.py). Sold as unique:<id>.

cc_archivists_cowl.name: Archivist's Cowl
cc_archivists_cowl.flavor_text: A deep red cowl with a reading lens sewn into the brim.

cc_codex_bound_gloves.name: Codex-Bound Gloves
cc_codex_bound_gloves.flavor_text: Ink-stained to the knuckle. The Codex counts that as a qualification.

cc_marginalia_of_the_deep.name: Marginalia of the Deep
cc_marginalia_of_the_deep.flavor_text: Notes in the margins of a book nobody has finished. Some of them are answers.

cc_bastion_warden_girdle.name: Bastion Warden's Girdle
cc_bastion_warden_girdle.flavor_text: Worn by the blood elves who hold the Bastion's stair against whatever climbs it.

cc_lamplighter_boots.name: Lamplighter's Boots
cc_lamplighter_boots.flavor_text: Soft-soled, for the ones who carry the lamps out past where the light reaches.

cc_signet_of_the_find.name: Signet of the Find
cc_signet_of_the_find.flavor_text: A find, not a discovery. A find was already there.

og_grunts_warhelm.name: Grunt's Warhelm
og_grunts_warhelm.flavor_text: Red iron with a nose guard. Every grunt's first helm looks like it, and the good ones keep it.

og_korkron_shoulderguards.name: Kor'kron Shoulderguards
og_korkron_shoulderguards.flavor_text: Spiked pauldrons in the Warchief's colours, made for standing in a doorway.

og_farseers_mail_vest.name: Farseer's Mail Vest
og_farseers_mail_vest.flavor_text: Hung with wolf-tooth charms that rattle before the lightning comes.

og_wolfrider_leggings.name: Wolfrider's Leggings
og_wolfrider_leggings.flavor_text: Worn smooth on the inside of the knee by years in a wolf's saddle.

og_spiritwalker_bracers.name: Spiritwalker's Bracers
og_spiritwalker_bracers.flavor_text: Bound with blue cord, the way the old shaman bound them.

og_band_of_the_red_stone.name: Band of the Red Stone
og_band_of_the_red_stone.flavor_text: Cut from the same red rock as the city's walls.

ds_headhunters_mask.name: Headhunter's Mask
ds_headhunters_mask.flavor_text: A carved wooden mask with tusks. The eye holes are smaller than you'd expect.

ds_hexers_robe.name: Hexer's Robe
ds_hexers_robe.flavor_text: Stitched with little bone charms. The Darkspear's hexers wear it to remind Zalazane who's still here.

ds_bonecharm_necklace.name: Bonecharm Necklace
ds_bonecharm_necklace.flavor_text: Fish bones and a carved shell on a cord. A witch doctor blessed every one.

ds_tidewalker_waders.name: Tidewalker Waders
ds_tidewalker_waders.flavor_text: For wading out to the isles at low tide, where the drowned ones wait.

ds_shadow_hunters_bracers.name: Shadow Hunter's Bracers
ds_shadow_hunters_bracers.flavor_text: Painted with the marks of a shadow hunter who never gave his name.

ds_spearguard_girdle.name: Spearguard Girdle
ds_spearguard_girdle.flavor_text: A troll warrior's belt, notched where the spear rests.

fs_apothecarys_gloves.name: Apothecary's Gloves
fs_apothecarys_gloves.flavor_text: Waxed gloves from the Apothecarium. The stains won't come out, and nobody asks what they are.

fs_deathstalkers_hood.name: Deathstalker's Hood
fs_deathstalkers_hood.flavor_text: Grey and close-fitting. Deathstalkers don't want to be remembered by their faces.

fs_dark_ranger_spaulders.name: Dark Ranger's Spaulders
fs_dark_ranger_spaulders.flavor_text: Black mail edged in silver, after the Banshee Queen's own rangers.

fs_deathguard_legplates.name: Deathguard Legplates
fs_deathguard_legplates.flavor_text: The Deathguard hold Brill's road. These hold the Deathguard up.

fs_grave_cold_band.name: Grave-Cold Band
fs_grave_cold_band.flavor_text: Cold to the touch, and it never warms however long you wear it.

fs_shroud_of_the_wakened.name: Shroud of the Wakened
fs_shroud_of_the_wakened.flavor_text: Cut from a burial shroud by someone who woke up in it.

sc_bruisers_gauntlets.name: Cartel Bruiser's Gauntlets
sc_bruisers_gauntlets.flavor_text: Brass knuckles built into the plate. The Cartel's neutrality is enforced.

sc_contractors_belt.name: Contractor's Belt
sc_contractors_belt.flavor_text: Six pockets, and every one has a receipt in it.

sc_wharf_inspectors_coat.name: Wharf Inspector's Coat
sc_wharf_inspectors_coat.flavor_text: Chain under a goblin's long coat. Inspections in Ratchet are occasionally contested.

sc_neutral_ground_mantle.name: Neutral Ground Mantle
sc_neutral_ground_mantle.flavor_text: Horde red on one shoulder, Alliance blue on the other. Diplomacy, the goblin way.

sc_tidepaid_ring.name: Tidepaid Ring
sc_tidepaid_ring.flavor_text: Paid out by the tide's ledger. The Cartel insures its healers.

sc_harbourmasters_slippers.name: Harbourmaster's Slippers
sc_harbourmasters_slippers.flavor_text: Soft enough to walk the quay at night without waking the dockhands.

tb_spireborn_headdress.name: Spireborn Headdress
tb_spireborn_headdress.flavor_text: Feathers from the eagles that nested on the spires. There aren't any more of them.

tb_plainsrunner_leggings.name: Plainsrunner's Leggings
tb_plainsrunner_leggings.flavor_text: For running the Barrens. Nobody runs Mulgore any more.

tb_taurajo_bulwark_girdle.name: Taurajo Bulwark Girdle
tb_taurajo_bulwark_girdle.flavor_text: Heavy enough to anchor a tauren against a charging kodo, which is the test.

tb_windhoof_bracers.name: Windhoof Bracers
tb_windhoof_bracers.flavor_text: Kodo hide, bound with sinew. A druid's in cat form never notices them.

tb_earthmothers_mantle.name: Earthmother's Mantle
tb_earthmothers_mantle.flavor_text: Carved stone beads on the shoulders, one for every spire.

tb_totem_of_the_lost_spires.name: Totem of the Lost Spires
tb_totem_of_the_lost_spires.flavor_text: Four little spires carved on a single stick. The shaman who sells it won't talk about the fourth.

bb_harbour_guard_helm.name: Harbour Guard's Helm
bb_harbour_guard_helm.flavor_text: Dented by cannonballs, polished for the Baron.

bb_corsair_hunter_vest.name: Corsair-Hunter's Vest
bb_corsair_hunter_vest.flavor_text: Light enough to swim in, which matters more on Booty Bay's payroll than it should.

bb_navigators_belt.name: Navigator's Belt
bb_navigators_belt.flavor_text: A sextant pouch on one hip and a lightning charm on the other.

bb_barons_waistcoat.name: Baron's Silk Waistcoat
bb_barons_waistcoat.flavor_text: Cut for the Baron's fitting and sold when he grew out of it.

bb_tide_readers_gloves.name: Tide-Reader's Gloves
bb_tide_readers_gloves.flavor_text: Cold, and they always feel wet, and the tide tables are stitched on the palms.

bb_cannoneers_ring.name: Cannoneer's Ring
bb_cannoneers_ring.flavor_text: A brass ring blackened by powder. It's been close to a lot of loud things.

ac_forgeguard_breastplate.name: Ashhold Forgeguard Breastplate
ac_forgeguard_breastplate.flavor_text: Dark iron, hammered on the deed-holder's own anvil.

ac_riggers_gloves.name: Cinderwharf Rigger's Gloves
ac_riggers_gloves.flavor_text: Tarred palms for climbing rigging in the wind off the volcano.

ac_scoria_pauldrons.name: Scoria-Plated Pauldrons
ac_scoria_pauldrons.flavor_text: Plates of cooled volcanic glass on a mail frame. Light, sharp and hot to the touch.

ac_pyremongers_hood.name: Pyremonger's Hood
ac_pyremongers_hood.flavor_text: A Dark Iron fire-priest's hood, singed around the eye slits.

ac_deed_holders_signet.name: Deed-Holder's Signet
ac_deed_holders_signet.flavor_text: A copy of the Ashhold seal. The original is in a vault the goblins insured.

ac_ashpriests_bindings.name: Ashpriest's Bindings
ac_ashpriests_bindings.flavor_text: Wraps a Dark Iron healer wears so the forge-burns on her wrists don't show.

er_sentinel_glaivebelt.name: Sentinel's Glaivebelt
er_sentinel_glaivebelt.flavor_text: A hook at the hip for a glaive, worn by the Sentinels on the Fel Line.

er_timbermaw_hide_leggings.name: Timbermaw Hide Leggings
er_timbermaw_hide_leggings.flavor_text: Furbolg-tanned and heavy. The Timbermaw make them for the ones who stand in front.

er_grovewardens_robe.name: Grovewarden's Robe
er_grovewardens_robe.flavor_text: Green as the cleansed glade, and it smells of moonflowers.

er_reclaimers_hauberk.name: Reclaimer's Hauberk
er_reclaimers_hauberk.flavor_text: A Sentinel ranger's hauberk, cut down for a transplant who earned it.

er_treant_bark_wristguards.name: Treant-Bark Wristguards
er_treant_bark_wristguards.flavor_text: Shed bark from an old treant, bound over steel. He said he didn't need it.

er_moonwell_pendant.name: Moonwell Pendant
er_moonwell_pendant.flavor_text: A drop of the Sanctuary's moonwell, sealed in glass. It glows faintly at night.

cc_staff_of_the_hanging_light.name: Staff of the Hanging Light
cc_staff_of_the_hanging_light.flavor_text: Nobody's reached the light at the bottom of the Underdark. This is the closest anyone's come.

cc_crimson_spellblade.name: Crimson Spellblade
cc_crimson_spellblade.flavor_text: Sunstrider steel. It was made to cut spells, and it hasn't forgotten how.

cc_bastion_wardens_blade.name: Bastion Warden's Blade
cc_bastion_wardens_blade.flavor_text: Three hundred steps down, and nothing has ever got past the top one.

og_warchiefs_due.name: Warchief's Due
og_warchiefs_due.flavor_text: Every Horde forge owes the Warchief one blade. This is the one he kept.

og_bulwark_of_the_valley.name: Bulwark of the Valley
og_bulwark_of_the_valley.flavor_text: Every orc learns to stand in the Valley of Trials. Some never stop.

og_farseers_ancestral_mace.name: Farseer's Ancestral Mace
og_farseers_ancestral_mace.flavor_text: Carved with every farseer's name back to Draenor. There's room for yours.

ds_spear_of_the_last_island.name: Spear of the Last Island
ds_spear_of_the_last_island.flavor_text: Cut from the last island the Darkspear held. They want the rest back.

ds_kangaris_hexing_staff.name: Kang'ari's Spirit Staff
ds_kangaris_hexing_staff.flavor_text: The spirits don't take orders. They do take requests, if you ask politely.

ds_senjin_throwing_axes.name: Sen'jin's Throwing Axes
ds_senjin_throwing_axes.flavor_text: They always come back. The trick is being there to catch them.

fs_banshees_lament.name: Banshee's Lament
fs_banshees_lament.flavor_text: The string sighs when you draw it. The target never hears it.

fs_blade_of_the_wakened.name: Blade of the Wakened
fs_blade_of_the_wakened.flavor_text: Taken from the Scourge by the first of the dead to wake. It never went back.

fs_plaguebearers_staff.name: Plaguebearer's Staff
fs_plaguebearers_staff.flavor_text: A sealed vial from the Apothecarium rides at the tip. Please don't drop it.

sc_profit_margin.name: Profit Margin
sc_profit_margin.flavor_text: Thin, sharp and easy to miss, like every good goblin deal.

sc_the_neutrality_clause.name: The Neutrality Clause
sc_the_neutrality_clause.flavor_text: The Cartel's terms are painted on the front. Breaking them costs extra.

sc_arbiters_cloak.name: Cartel Arbiter's Cloak
sc_arbiters_cloak.flavor_text: Disputes on the quay are settled once. Nobody appeals.

tb_spire_wardens_staff.name: Spire-Warden's Staff
tb_spire_wardens_staff.flavor_text: If you can hold them, I can heal you - R

tb_mulgore_greatbow.name: Mulgore Greatbow
tb_mulgore_greatbow.flavor_text: Strung for the plains the way they were. Its hunters mean to see them again.

tb_cloak_of_the_fallen_spires.name: Cloak of the Fallen Spires
tb_cloak_of_the_fallen_spires.flavor_text: Four spires woven into the border, and nothing beneath them.

bb_revilgaz_cutlass.name: Revilgaz's Cutlass
bb_revilgaz_cutlass.flavor_text: The Baron keeps a lot of spares. He's very particular about who gets one.

bb_port_authority_blunderbuss.name: Port Authority Blunderbuss
bb_port_authority_blunderbuss.flavor_text: Licensed, stamped and loaded with whatever was cheapest that week.

bb_cloak_of_the_deep_harbour.name: Cloak of the Deep Harbour
bb_cloak_of_the_deep_harbour.flavor_text: The last deep-water harbour in the world, worn on your shoulders.

ac_thanes_claim.name: Thane's Claim
ac_thanes_claim.flavor_text: The deed to Khaz Varun is engraved down the haft. Nobody contests it.

ac_firebrand_scepter.name: Firebrand Scepter
ac_firebrand_scepter.flavor_text: Warm in the hand, hot at the head, and furious when it's swung.

ac_khaz_varun_deedstone.name: Khaz Varun Deedstone
ac_khaz_varun_deedstone.flavor_text: A chip of the gate. Whoever holds the gate holds the hall.

er_moonboughs_gift.name: Moonbough's Gift
er_moonboughs_gift.flavor_text: Grown, not made, around a moonstone, by the Arch Druid's own hand.

er_glaive_of_the_fel_line.name: Glaive of the Fel Line
er_glaive_of_the_fel_line.flavor_text: The Fel Line moves north a little every week. This is why.

er_windcallers_bough.name: Windcaller's Bough
er_windcallers_bough.flavor_text: Every spring, leaves grow out of the spine. The Timbermaw say it's listening.

pf_sorrow_hill_bulwark_helm.name: Sorrow Hill Bulwark Helm
pf_sorrow_hill_bulwark_helm.flavor_text: Plain grey plate. The Crusade's flame was ground off the brow and nothing was put back.

pf_flamewardens_mantle.name: Flamewarden's Mantle
pf_flamewardens_mantle.flavor_text: The Order's pale flame, stitched white on grey over both shoulders.

pf_defectors_brigandine.name: Defector's Brigandine
pf_defectors_brigandine.flavor_text: Crusade leather with the tabard torn off. The stitch holes are still there.

pf_uthers_vigil_gauntlets.name: Uther's Vigil Gauntlets
pf_uthers_vigil_gauntlets.flavor_text: Worn by the Order's healers who keep the night watch at the tomb.

pf_ironworkers_girdle.name: Ironworker's Girdle
pf_ironworkers_girdle.flavor_text: The Flamekeeper makes a few of these himself in the evenings, and he won't say why.

pf_pale_flame_signet.name: Pale Flame Signet
pf_pale_flame_signet.flavor_text: A white flame on a steel band. There was a red one there once.

pf_callahans_rivet_maul.name: Callahan's Rivet Maul
pf_callahans_rivet_maul.flavor_text: Rory Callahan forged it from the rivets of a Crusade gate he helped tear down.

pf_shield_of_the_walkout.name: Shield of the Walkout
pf_shield_of_the_walkout.flavor_text: Carried out of the Crusade the night the Order left, and never repainted.

pf_staff_of_the_pale_flame.name: Staff of the Pale Flame
pf_staff_of_the_pale_flame.flavor_text: A white flame burns at the head of it, and it has never once burned anyone.

ad_argent_vanguard_breastplate.name: Argent Vanguard Breastplate
ad_argent_vanguard_breastplate.flavor_text: Silvered plate for whoever stands at the front of the wall tonight.

ad_lightwardens_cord.name: Lightwarden's Cord
ad_lightwardens_cord.flavor_text: A chapel healer's cord, blessed so often the threads have gone pale.

ad_dawnstrider_leggings.name: Dawnstrider Leggings
ad_dawnstrider_leggings.flavor_text: Cut for the Dawn's scouts, who run the dead roads between Light's Hope and the Crown Guard camp.

ad_chapel_ward_hauberk.name: Chapel Ward Hauberk
ad_chapel_ward_hauberk.flavor_text: Argent mail with a sprig of holy thistle sewn into the collar.

ad_scourgebane_wristwraps.name: Scourgebane Wristwraps
ad_scourgebane_wristwraps.flavor_text: Silver thread, and the names of the Dawn's dead written along it.

ad_argent_crusaders_sabatons.name: Argent Crusader's Sabatons
ad_argent_crusaders_sabatons.flavor_text: Heavy boots for a paladin who means to walk into Stratholme and out again.

ad_light_hope_greatbow.name: Light's Hope Greatbow
ad_light_hope_greatbow.flavor_text: Strung with silvered gut. The Dawn's archers say the dead can hear it coming.

ad_argent_avengers_blade.name: Argent Avenger's Blade
ad_argent_avengers_blade.flavor_text: Light, quick and silvered. It was made for the ones who go over the wall at night.

ad_tome_of_the_last_vigil.name: Tome of the Last Vigil
ad_tome_of_the_last_vigil.flavor_text: The Dawn's book of every night the wall held. There's a page left at the back for tonight.

tm_honeywood_bulwark_helm.name: Honeywood Bulwark Helm
tm_honeywood_bulwark_helm.flavor_text: Plate beaten over a cap of carved honeywood. The Hold's smiths line everything with wood.

tm_windtalkers_shoulderwraps.name: Windtalker's Shoulderwraps
tm_windtalkers_shoulderwraps.flavor_text: Woven by the spring, from wool the Timbermaw trade for with the night elves.

tm_pathfinders_jerkin.name: Pathfinder's Jerkin
tm_pathfinders_jerkin.flavor_text: Worn soft by a lot of mornings walking the tunnel down to Felwood.

tm_featherkeepers_cord.name: Featherkeeper's Cord
tm_featherkeepers_cord.flavor_text: A belt of braided hide with one clean feather tied at the knot, for every one that's burned.

tm_mossmane_signet.name: Mossmane Signet
tm_mossmane_signet.flavor_text: Elder Haldor's own family mark, a bear's paw pressed into dark amber.

tm_maul_of_the_elders.name: Maul of the Elders
tm_maul_of_the_elders.flavor_text: A totem pole's top, cut off and hafted. The Elders say the bear on it was a real one.

tm_staff_of_the_hold.name: Staff of the Hold
tm_staff_of_the_hold.flavor_text: Honeywood, iron-shod at the foot. It's for whoever stands in the tunnel when the Deadwood come.

tm_brightpelts_spirit_totem.name: Brightpelt's Spirit Totem
tm_brightpelts_spirit_totem.flavor_text: A little carved totem Selva keeps by the spring. She made a second one and won't say who for.

tm_totemcarved_bracers.name: Totem-Carved Bracers
tm_totemcarved_bracers.flavor_text: Thick hide bracers with a bear's head carved into the wooden backing of each one.

sc_sunreach_spellweave_robe.name: Sunreach Spellweave Robe
sc_sunreach_spellweave_robe.flavor_text: Red and gold silk the Conclave brought by ship from Quel'Thalas, before there was no Quel'Thalas to sail from.

sc_dawnwatch_spaulders.name: Dawnwatch Spaulders
sc_dawnwatch_spaulders.flavor_text: Plate for the magisters' guards, chased with a sunburst that warms in the light.

sc_leystriders_boots.name: Leystrider's Boots
sc_leystriders_boots.flavor_text: Soft boots for walking the leylines, soled with a leather that never quite touches the ground.

sc_tidewarders_hauberk.name: Tidewarder's Hauberk
sc_tidewarders_hauberk.flavor_text: Mail the Conclave's wardens wear on the coast, its rings blessed against the salt.

sc_spellbreakers_vambraces.name: Spellbreaker's Vambraces
sc_spellbreakers_vambraces.flavor_text: Worn by the Spellbreakers who watch the Landing's gate, and the orcs who argue with them.

sc_sunreach_signet.name: Sunreach Signet
sc_sunreach_signet.flavor_text: The Grand Magister's house mark, a sun rising over a line of sea.

sc_staff_of_the_last_spire.name: Staff of the Last Spire
sc_staff_of_the_last_spire.flavor_text: Cut from the top of a spire that fell into the sea, and carried out of Quel'Thalas by the Grand Magister herself.

sc_dawnblade_of_the_conclave.name: Dawnblade of the Conclave
sc_dawnblade_of_the_conclave.flavor_text: A Spellbreaker's sword, made for the Conclave's champion. The Conclave hasn't chosen one yet.

sc_tome_of_the_sunken_court.name: Tome of the Sunken Court
sc_tome_of_the_sunken_court.flavor_text: Highborne court records the dig brought up, rebound in Conclave red. The magisters still argue about what's in it.

liq_liquidators_dosimeter.name: Liquidator's Dosimeter
liq_liquidators_dosimeter.flavor_text: Kenji builds them out of Seep-glass and cat gut. It clicks faster when you're somewhere you shouldn't be, which in Deadwind is most places.

liq_decon_suit_robe.name: Decontamination Suit
liq_decon_suit_robe.flavor_text: Oilcloth over silk, sealed at every seam with wax. The Forsaken think the living wear far too many layers.

liq_pyre_tenders_gauntlets.name: Pyre-Tender's Gauntlets
liq_pyre_tenders_gauntlets.flavor_text: Old Tobiah's spare pair. He says the green fire doesn't burn plate, only the hands inside it.

liq_wireline_boots.name: Wireline Boots
liq_wireline_boots.flavor_text: Corporal Delgado's patrols wear through a pair a week walking the fence.

liq_sample_runners_hauberk.name: Sample-Runner's Hauberk
liq_sample_runners_hauberk.flavor_text: Mail for the runners who carry Morwen's samples back across the pass, washed at the troughs every time.

liq_quarantine_wardens_girdle.name: Quarantine Warden's Girdle
liq_quarantine_wardens_girdle.flavor_text: Deathguard Harrow's own design, with a hook for the gate key and another for the ledger.

liq_board_of_names_band.name: Band of the Board
liq_board_of_names_band.flavor_text: Every name on the board by the pyre is scratched inside it, very small, and there's room for more.

liq_staff_of_the_long_shift.name: Staff of the Long Shift
liq_staff_of_the_long_shift.flavor_text: Cut from a dead Deadwind oak and capped with Seep-glass. It glows when the wound is close, so you'll know.

liq_liquidators_shovel.name: The Liquidator's Spade
liq_liquidators_shovel.flavor_text: The men on the reactor roof cleared the graphite with spades, ninety seconds at a time. This one's for the pass.

liq_fence_runners_knife.name: Fence-Runner's Knife
liq_fence_runners_knife.flavor_text: Ray Delgado's, from before he came over. He won't say what he used it for in Utah, only that it was legal.

cc_moonbough_pendant.name: Moonwell Rim Pendant
cc_moonbough_pendant.flavor_text: A sliver of the great moonwell's rim, set in living wood. It's warm in the morning and cold at night.

cc_grove_wardens_vest.name: Grove Warden's Vest
cc_grove_wardens_vest.flavor_text: Bark-tanned leather the Circle's wardens wear on the Barrow Dens' door, lined for long nights.

cc_moonwell_keepers_cowl.name: Moonwell Keeper's Cowl
cc_moonwell_keepers_cowl.flavor_text: Aedris Silverbrook sews one for every keeper she trains, and she's trained a great many.

cc_thornward_greaves.name: Thornward Greaves
cc_thornward_greaves.flavor_text: Plate grown over with a living ward of thorn, so whoever stands in them stands like a hedge.

cc_stormcrow_mantle.name: Stormcrow Mantle
cc_stormcrow_mantle.flavor_text: Feathers from the crows that roost over the Shrine of Remulos, worked into mail by tauren hands.

cc_band_of_the_glade.name: Band of the Glade
cc_band_of_the_glade.flavor_text: A ring of pale wood from a branch the great tree dropped the night the worlds came together.

cc_barrow_wardens_bracers.name: Barrow Warden's Bracers
cc_barrow_wardens_bracers.flavor_text: Warden Grayhoof's own pattern. He says they're for leaning on a door all night, and he isn't joking.

cc_staff_of_the_moonglade.name: Staff of the Moonglade
cc_staff_of_the_moonglade.flavor_text: Cut from the great tree with Remulos's leave, and it still grows a leaf in spring.

cc_thornheart_maul.name: Thornheart Maul
cc_thornheart_maul.flavor_text: Hamuul Runetotem carried it out of Thunder Bluff. He says it's for a bear's paw, not a tauren's hand.

cc_nighthaven_longbow.name: Nighthaven Longbow
cc_nighthaven_longbow.flavor_text: Strung with moonwell-soaked gut. The Circle's wardens have never once missed a shot at night with one.

wk_locket_of_the_last_memory.name: Locket of the Last Memory
wk_locket_of_the_last_memory.flavor_text: Every Wakened carries one. There's nothing inside it until you put something there.

wk_longhouse_jerkin.name: Longhouse Jerkin
wk_longhouse_jerkin.flavor_text: Cut by people who'd never cut leather before, and refitted until it was right.

wk_night_nurses_robes.name: Night Nurse's Robes
wk_night_nurses_robes.flavor_text: Adaeze Okafor's pattern: deep pockets, no loose sleeves, and a hood for sitting up through the night.

wk_boots_of_the_first_morning.name: Boots of the First Morning
wk_boots_of_the_first_morning.flavor_text: The Wakened all remember their first morning here. These are for walking into the next one.

wk_carvers_gauntlets.name: Carver's Gauntlets
wk_carvers_gauntlets.flavor_text: Hamish MacLeod's, worn thin at the fingertips from carving the wall of last memories.

wk_sleepwalkers_cord.name: Sleepwalker's Cord
wk_sleepwalkers_cord.flavor_text: Tied round the waist of anyone who walks in their sleep, so the night watch can find them by morning.

wk_night_watch_shield.name: Night Watch Shield
wk_night_watch_shield.flavor_text: The Wakened keep a watch every night by the dream cots. Somebody has to be awake.

wk_the_waking_ledger.name: The Waking Ledger
wk_the_waking_ledger.flavor_text: Ingrid Sandvik's notebook of every dream the Wakened have told her. She made a copy for you.

wk_ribeiros_hammer.name: Ribeiro's Hammer
wk_ribeiros_hammer.flavor_text: Tomas Ribeiro made it with the first iron the Wakened ever smelted. It's ugly and it's never broken.

wk_blade_of_the_wakeful.name: Blade of the Wakeful
wk_blade_of_the_wakeful.flavor_text: For the ones who keep the night watch. It's light enough to hold all night and sharp enough to matter.

fms_feathermoon_crescent.name: Feathermoon Crescent
fms_feathermoon_crescent.flavor_text: A silver crescent on a cord of braided hippogryph feather. Every Sentinel on the walls wears one.

fms_huntress_jerkin.name: Feathermoon Huntress Jerkin
fms_huntress_jerkin.flavor_text: Cut close for running the coast at night, and dyed the deep violet of the island's banners.

fms_moonsilk_cowl.name: Sentinel's Moonsilk Cowl
fms_moonsilk_cowl.flavor_text: Worn by the priestesses who keep the moonwell, with a hood deep enough to hide the face in a storm.

fms_tidewatch_greaves.name: Tidewatch Greaves
fms_tidewatch_greaves.flavor_text: Pale plate for the Sentinels who hold the sandbar to Sardor Isle, built to stand in the surf.

fms_owlfeather_spaulders.name: Owlfeather Spaulders
fms_owlfeather_spaulders.flavor_text: Mail trimmed with owl feathers, so a huntress can turn her head without a sound.

fms_band_of_the_island.name: Band of the Island
fms_band_of_the_island.flavor_text: Carved from the pale stone of Feathermoon's walls. It's said the island never lets its sisters drown.

fms_sardor_watch_bracers.name: Sardor Watch Bracers
fms_sardor_watch_bracers.flavor_text: The healers who wade out to the sandbar wear these, so the sea can't take the tools from their hands.

fms_feathermoon_greatbow.name: Feathermoon Moonbolt Crossbow
fms_feathermoon_greatbow.flavor_text: The Sentinels on the walls of Feathermoon keep these for the long shots out over the water, where a bow can't reach.

fms_crescent_glaive.name: Crescent Moonblade
fms_crescent_glaive.flavor_text: A curved Sentinel blade, light enough to throw and balanced to come back to the hand that knows it.

fms_staff_of_the_watchful_moon.name: Staff of the Watchful Moon
fms_staff_of_the_watchful_moon.flavor_text: Kindal Moonweaver's own staff, or one cut to the same pattern. It hums when the tide turns.
